summary: The root "rjz" primarily describes a camel's disease. It also refers to reciting a specific poetic meter called "rajaz.
lane: 1 رَجِزَ ذ , [aor. رَجَزَ ,] (S,) inf. n. رَجَزٌ , (TA,) He (a camel) had the disease termed رَجَزٌ [expl. below]. (S.) -A2- رَجَزَ , (S, Msb, K,) aor. رَجُزَ , (Msb, TA,) inf. n. رَجْزٌ , (TA,) He said, spoke, uttered, or recited, poetry, or verse, of the metre termed رَجَزٌ ; [see this word below;] he spoke in verse of that metre; he poetized, or versified, in that metre; as also ; (S, * Msb, K, * TA;) and in like manner , he composed verses of that metre. (Ibn-Buzurj, L in art. قصد .) You say also, رَجَزَبِهِ He recited to him ( أَنْشَدَهُ [so in more than one MS. copy of the K, and in the TA, but in the CK أَنْشَدَ , without the affixed pronoun, which is probably wrong,]) a poem of that metre; as also , (K, TA,) inf. n. تَرْجِيزٌ . (TA.) And He urged, or excited, his camels by singing رَجَز , or his رَجَز : so accord. to different copies of the K. (TA.) -b2- [Hence,] رَجَزَتِ الرِّيحُ , inf. n. رَجْزٌ , (assumed tropical:) The wind was continuous, or lasting. (TA.) And الرَّعْدُ (tropical:) The thunder made uninterrupted sounds, like the recitation of the رَاجِز : (A, TA:) or, as also , made a sound: (K:) or made consecutive sounds. (TA.) And البَحْرُ بَآذِيِّهِ (tropical:) [ The sea makes a continuous sound, or murmuring, with its waves ]; as also . (A, TA.) [And hence, perhaps,] السَّحَابُ (tropical:) The clouds moved slowly by reason of the abundance of their water. (K, TA.) [See also 6.]

headwords.def: رَاجِزٌ One who utters, or recites, poetry, or verse, of the metre termed رَجَزٌ ; who speaks in verse of that metre; who poetizes, or versifies, in that metre: and in like manner, , and [which signifies one who does so much ], and [one who does so very much ]. (TA.) El-'Ajjáj has been placed the highest in rank as a راجز . (Mz, 49th نوع .) [His son, Ru-beh, seems to occupy nearly an equal place. Each of them composed a complete deewán of رَجَز .] [Hence,] سَحَابَةٌ (tropical:) [ A cloud thundering much, or uninterruptedly ]. (A, TA.) And غَيْثٌ , and , (tropical:) Rain accompanied by thunder. (TA.)

headwords.def: أَرْجَزُ A camel having the disease termed رَجَزٌ : fem. رَجْزَآءُ : (S, K:) the latter is explained as signifying weak in the rump, that does not move from her place unless after twice or thrice rising from the place where she lay: and that does not rise, when she desires to do so, unless after vehement trembling. (TA.) [Hence,] إِنَّهَا لَرَجْزَآءُ , said of the wind ( الرِّيح ), (assumed tropical:) Verily it is continuous, or lasting. (TA.) And رَجْزَآءُ القِيَامِ (tropical:) A great, heavy cooking-pot. (TA.)
